DT_CHOSEN_ZEPHYR_FACILITY := zephyr,retention

config DT_ZEPHYR_RETENTION_HAS_CHECKSUM
	def_bool $(dt_nodelabel_bool_prop,retention,checksum) || \
		 $(dt_compat_any_has_prop,$(DT_COMPAT_ZEPHYR_RETENTION),checksum,1) || \
		 $(dt_compat_any_has_prop,$(DT_COMPAT_ZEPHYR_RETENTION),checksum,2) || \
		 $(dt_compat_any_has_prop,$(DT_COMPAT_ZEPHYR_RETENTION),checksum,4)

menuconfig RETENTION
	bool "Retention system support"
	depends on DT_HAS_ZEPHYR_RETENTION_ENABLED
	depends on RETAINED_MEM
	select CRC if DT_ZEPHYR_RETENTION_HAS_CHECKSUM
	help
	  Enables support for the retention system, which checks and makes
	  available retained memory areas across resets using a single API.

if RETENTION

config RETENTION_INIT_PRIORITY
	int "Retention system init priority"
	default 86
	help
	  Retention devices initialization priority, must be initialized
	  after retained memory drivers.

config RETENTION_BUFFER_SIZE
	int "Internal buffer size used for retention checksum operations"
	default 16
	range 1 256
	help
	  Size of the internal buffer (in bytes, on the stack) used whilst
	  performing checksum calculation/verification when reading from
	  retained memory.

config RETENTION_MUTEXES
	bool "Retention mutex support"
	default y if MULTITHREADING
	depends on MULTITHREADING
	help
	  Use mutexes to prevent issues with concurrent retention area access.
	  Should only be disabled in single-threaded applications or when
	  calling module safeguards access directly.

module = RETENTION
module-str = retention
source "subsys/logging/Kconfig.template.log_config"

source "subsys/retention/Kconfig.boot_mode"
source "subsys/retention/Kconfig.blinfo"

endif # RETENTION
